```{python}
#| label: fig-dom
#| fig-cap: "Pareto Dominance"

import plotly.graph_objects as go
fig = go.Figure()

pf_points = [(x, 1/x**2) for x in [1,1.3,2, 3,4]]
ref_point = [4.5, 1.2]

for pf_x, pf_y in pf_points:
  fig.add_trace(
    go.Scatter(visible=True,
               x=[pf_x,ref_point[0], ref_point[0], pf_x, pf_x],
               y=[pf_y, pf_y, ref_point[1], ref_point[1], pf_y],
               fill="toself", mode="lines", legendgroup=pf_x,
               marker=dict(color="blue"),)
  )
  fig.add_trace(
    go.Scatter(visible=True, x=[pf_x], y=[pf_y],
               mode="markers", showlegend=False, legendgroup=pf_x,
               marker=dict(color="blue"),)
  )



fig.add_trace(
  go.Scatter(visible=True, x=[ref_point[0]], y=[ref_point[1]],
             mode="markers", name="Reference point",
             marker=dict(color="red"),legendrank=1)
)
fig.update_layout(yaxis_range=(0, 1.3))
fig.update_layout(xaxis_range=(0.77, 5))

fig.show()

```


```{python}
#| label: fig-dom-3d
#| fig-cap: "Pareto Dominance 3d"

import plotly.graph_objects as go
fig = go.Figure()

pf_points = [(x, 1/x**2, 1/x**2) for x in [1,1.3,2, 3,4]]
ref_point = [4.5, 1.2, 1.2]

for pf_x, pf_y, pf_z in pf_points:
  fig.add_trace(
    go.Mesh3d(visible=True,
              x=[pf_x,ref_point[0], ref_point[0], pf_x, pf_x, ref_point[0], ref_point[0], pf_x],
              y=[pf_y, pf_y, ref_point[1], ref_point[1], pf_y, pf_y, ref_point[1], ref_point[1]],
              z=[pf_z, pf_z, pf_z, pf_z,  ref_point[2], ref_point[2], ref_point[2], ref_point[2]],
              i = [7, 0, 0, 0, 4, 4, 6, 6, 4, 0, 3, 2],
              j = [3, 4, 1, 2, 5, 6, 5, 2, 0, 1, 6, 3],
              k = [0, 7, 2, 3, 6, 7, 1, 1, 5, 5, 7, 6],
              flatshading=True,
              opacity=0.2,
              color="blue",
              legendgroup=pf_x,
              )
  )
  fig.add_trace(
    go.Scatter3d(visible=True, x=[pf_x], y=[pf_y],z=[pf_z],
               mode="markers", legendgroup=pf_x,
               marker=dict(color="blue"),)
  )

fig.update_layout(scene= dict(
  yaxis=dict(range=[0, 1.3]),
  xaxis=dict(range=[0.77, 5]),
  zaxis=dict(range=[0, 1.3]),
))
fig.show()

```
